high_level_description: stc brand style, a chalkboard-style movie poster graphic for the film 'Looper' promoted through the streaming service.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A gray chalkboard texture with a white sketch-style border featuring diagonal motion lines, and a wooden frame element on the left side.

elements.desc: A central figure wearing a gray suit and tie, depicted in a mirrored, reversed pose against a white background with diagonal gray lines.
The film title at the bottom of the poster and repeated below in chalk-style text.
